Slots #2, #1, #4, #5, #3 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #6 ranks 6 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.016 R/G.
Slot #2 yields 4.53 expected PA/game vs 4.10 at primary slot #6. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
